name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Egg Holder Basket
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, durable and lightweight.
    - Main panel: Wooden panel with 3mm thickness.
    - Egg holder panels: Wooden pieces with 3mm thickness.
    - Base: Wooden panel with 5mm thickness.
    - Smooth laser-cut edges ensure a clean finish and safe handling.
    - Sturdy base design provides stable tabletop placement.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 6.5 x 6.5 inches ~ 16.51 x 16.51 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for sharp details and vibrant, long-lasting colors.
    - Main panel, egg holder panels, and base: Double-sided printing.
    - Layered structure enhances visual depth and decorative appeal.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a decorative wooden egg holder basket for displaying Easter eggs or decorative eggs.
    - Includes easy-to-assemble egg holder components that securely support eggs.
    - Suitable for use as Easter décor, spring decorations, table centrepieces, or festive displays.
    - Ideal for placement on tables, shelves, kitchen counters, or party setups.
    📌 Note: 
    - The product requires assembly before use. Customers can easily assemble the product by slotting the pre-cut wooden pieces together. No tools or glue required.
    - Eggs are not included.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A charming and festive gift for kids, families, friends, and Easter lovers.
    - Perfect for Easter celebrations, spring events, holiday décor, and seasonal gifts.
    - A delightful decorative keepsake that adds warmth and joy to any space
     

 SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Egg Holder Basket

 

PRODUCTION

NOTE

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
